notes.title: Build 34 release notes
notes.notes: [p]Good news everyone: Brainmelter Deluxe is now free! As well, I've just patched it with a few quality of life updates: [/p][list][*][p]Level borders are now unlit, thus making the level layout easier to read at a glance[/p][/*][*][p]The player look left/right idle animation has been removed, as this was making it difficult to tell which you way you were looking when standing still[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for extreme screenshake at higher frame rates [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Android version now available!
notes.notes:
Hi folks, just a quick note to let you know that the Android version is now live on the [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CosmocatGames.BrainmelterDeluxe]Play Store[/url]! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33949043/75e9af625e3725bca5e23409eb28be569e0fbc84.png[/img]

P.S. if you've already bought the game for PC I will gladly send you a free copy of the Android version! Just drop me a line however is most convenient for you (Discord, Twitter, Facebook, email, etc.) and I will send instructions.
